'''Caben Jior''' was a [[human]] member of the [[Jedi Order]] during the [[High Republic Era]].<ref name="AcolyteVG" /> In [[132 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TheAcolyteDate}}</ref> they held the rank of [[Jedi Knight]] and were tasked with acting as a liaison to the influential [[Byne Guild]] of [[spacer]]s, monitoring reports from far-flung travelers.<ref name="AcolyteVG" /> That [[Standard year|year]],<ref name="Date" /> Jior walked with a [[human]] in<ref name="LostFound">{{Acolyte|Lost / Found}}</ref> [[Clothing|regulation survival gear]]<ref name="AcolyteVG" /> through a corridor by the launch bays of the [[Imperial Palace|Jedi Temple]] on<ref name="LostFound" /> the [[planet]]<ref name="Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]''</ref> [[Coruscant]], passing by [[Jedi Master]] [[Sol]] and<ref name="LostFound" /> his<ref name="AcolyteVG" /> [[Padawan]] [[Jecki Lon]].<ref name="LostFound" /> While at the temple, Jior wore [[Color|white]] and yellow [[temple robes]] with a brown [[Jedi utility belt]]<ref name="AcolyteVG" /> and brown [[boot]]s.<ref name="LostFound" /> The human had light skin, brown [[eye]]s, and brown [[hair]] with a graying beard.<ref name="AcolyteVG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Caben Jior first appeared in "[[Lost / Found]],"<ref name="LostFound" /> the first episode of the live-action television series ''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte]]'', which aired on [[Disney+]] on [[June 4]], [[2024]].<ref name="Announcement">{{SW|url=news/the-acolyte-teaser-poster|text=''The Acolyte'' Teaser Poster, Premiere Date Revealed}}</ref> The scenes in the Jedi Temple were shot at [[Shinfield Studios]],<ref name="Fantha Part I">{{WebCite|url=https://www.fanthatracks.com/news/the-acolyte-a-journey-to-the-filming-locations-part-1-madeira|text=The Acolyte: A journey to the filming locations Part 1: Madeira|archivedate=20241204220147}}</ref> [[Wikipedia:England|England]].<ref name="Julian Foddy">{{Lucasfilm|url=news/julian-foddy-acolyte|text=''The Acolyte'' Visual Effects Supervisor Julian Foddy}}</ref> The character was first identified in the [[2025]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte: The Visual Guide]]'', which was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]].<ref name="AcolyteVG" />
